bento.heading: Built for Tiptap
bento.subheading: Deeply embedded in Tiptap and works reliably through edits, reflows, and formatting changes

items.answer: Yes. Velt anchors each comment to a range in the Tiptap document and rebases that anchor as the surrounding content is edited. Comments stay attached to the right text even after multi-user edits, formatting changes, or block reflows.
items.question: Will comments move as the document changes?

items.answer: Yes. The Velt Tiptap integration ships as a Tiptap extension that composes alongside your own extensions without overriding their schema, commands, or keyboard shortcuts. You can keep using any other extensions you already have.
items.question: Does this work with custom Tiptap extensions?
